correctness.rationale: Exact killed-Brownian resolvent and target-visible OU return exit transforms give a finite-rate marked renewal identity. Boundary normalization and drift-free closed forms were independently checked using the included numerical verifier; these checks corroborate but do not prove the analytic general result.

value.rationale: Unlike a routine geometric-cycle mean, the theorem proves a complete dependent three-observable limit with a strict positive covariance, distinguishing physical first-passage time from a diverging number of switches and vanishing active-search exposure. It connects a measurable alarm counter to stochastic-return transport in optical trap protocols via a sharp scale-function constant. The joint limit and correlation give an interpretable new experimental statistic without claiming a paper-sized general theory.
